article.headline: Games To Watch: Magnolia gets SAHE playoff rematch; Unity visits Faith Christian
article.html:
Magnolia gets another look at SAHE on Saturday, this time in a playoff game. The Wildcats travel from Terry to Brandon for a 7 p.m. CDT kickoff on October 31, facing a Warriors team that beat them 76–32 earlier this month. SAHE enters 6–2; Magnolia is 2–7.

The earlier game in this focused Games To Watch selection is also a rematch: Unity Christian Academy visits Faith Christian HomeSchool Academy in Madison at 4 p.m. CDT. MaxPreps identifies it as a first-round playoff game. Faith Christian won the teams’ October meeting, so both games give the earlier loser another opportunity against a familiar opponent.

Magnolia at SAHE: a different finish to chase

SAHE’s 76–32 win came October 10 in Terry. Saturday reverses the venue, with Magnolia going to the Warriors’ home field. That first result is the clearest direct comparison between the teams, and it makes Magnolia’s response in the rematch the central question.

Their latest completed games brought different outcomes. Magnolia edged Gulf Coast Elite Homeschool 36–34 in Pascagoula on October 24, a result covered in our recap of the Wildcats’ road win. SAHE’s most recent result was a 46–20 loss at Clinton Christian Academy on October 23. Magnolia arrives after a close victory, while the Warriors are looking to follow a loss with a playoff win.

The reported offensive averages offer another comparison to watch. SAHE averages 189.8 rushing yards and 100.4 passing yards per game; Magnolia’s corresponding figures are 162.7 and 68.4. Those are season averages rather than a prediction, but they show the production Magnolia will be trying to match against an opponent that scored freely in the first meeting.

Unity at Faith Christian: the first meeting’s winner hosts

Faith Christian beat Unity 46–30 in Leland on October 2. This time the Tornadoes host in Madison. MaxPreps lists Unity at 4–4 and Faith Christian at 4–7 entering the game; the earlier head-to-head result gives Faith Christian a more favorable comparison than those overall records alone.

Unity comes off a 16–8 victory over Southwest Christian Academy on October 23. Faith Christian lost 39–14 at East Central HomeSchool that same date. The Soldiers bring the more recent winning result, while the Tornadoes have already shown they can win this matchup.
